name: Annas Garten
beschreibung: The hotel **Annas Garten** is located in a rural community in Tirol. The rooms are furnished with local woods and have a balcony or a terrace. The breakfast offering focuses on **regional ingredients** and products from its own garden. A sauna area is available to guests. Hiking trails and mountain bike routes are directly accessible from the accommodation. In winter, cross-country ski trails pass by near the house. The accommodation is aimed at guests seeking a relaxing stay in nature.
